title: Modelling of mineral construction and demolition waste dynamics through a combination of geospatial and image analysis
verified_interface: S2→S3 partial; upstream S1 uncertainty not carried through
evidence_note: Alternative lifetime profiles generate stochastic CDW scenarios; scenario spread reaches downstream waste estimates, but upstream geospatial/image uncertainty is not quantitatively propagated.

title: Dataset for Urban Scale Building Stock Modelling: Identification and Review of Potential Data Collection Approaches
evidence_note: Uncertain reality conditions and missing building information are recognized; no formal uncertainty state is propagated to stock estimates.

title: Semisupervised machine learning classification framework for material intensity parameters of residential buildings
verified_interface: S2 output is prepared for probabilistic downstream use
evidence_note: Probability distribution types and parameters are explicitly developed as inputs suitable for Monte Carlo and probabilistic stock-flow modelling, but the paper does not perform the downstream propagation.

title: What matters most to the material intensity coefficient of buildings? Random forest-based evidence from China
evidence_note: MIC uncertainty is recognized and differentiated across attribute levels; RF bootstrap is part of model fitting and RMSE evaluates performance, but an uncertainty distribution is not carried into stock outputs.

title: Building feature-based machine learning regression to quantify urban material stocks: A Hong Kong study
evidence_note: MAPE, RMSE and R² quantify predictive performance. These errors are not represented as a downstream uncertainty distribution in the city-scale stock estimate.

title: A Satellite-Driven Model for Monitoring Urban Material Metabolism, Embodied Emissions, and Carbonation
uncertainty_method: Material-intensity ranges; probabilistic emission factors; Monte Carlo; output CV/percentiles
verified_interface: Downstream quantitative handoff to emissions/carbonation; upstream EO uncertainty not verified
evidence_note: Supporting information assigns uncertainty ranges to material intensity, derives probabilistic emission factors through Monte Carlo, and reports output uncertainty using CV and percentile differences. Main article was not supplied.

title: Geometry-informed material intensity reveals considerable intra-archetype material variability of UK housing
uncertainty_method: Geometry-informed variability propagated to stock estimates
verified_interface: S1/S2 heterogeneity reaches stock estimate; no probability distribution downstream
evidence_note: Geometry-informed material intensities are applied to 225,704 houses; choice of MI produces 4.73 Mt / 18% discrepancy in stock estimates, showing quantitative transmission of representation variability without full probabilistic propagation.

title: Integrated BIM-GIS framework for holistic building stock assessment using 5D geo-modeling and digital twin concepts
study_area: Sixth District, 6th of October City, Giza
evidence_note: The study identifies uncertainty in upscaling and contextual variability but does not propagate a quantified uncertainty state through the BIM-GIS material-stock workflow.

title: Assessing the sensitivity of material-intensity-based building stock estimates to design parameters
study_area: Synthetic design space with plausibility checks
evidence_note: The study quantifies design-induced variability and tests sensitivity to GFA, but the synthetic design space is not a probability model and is explicitly not interpreted as real-world uncertainty propagation.

title: Exploration of urban deposits: Long-term prospects for resource and waste management
evidence_note: Full text was not present in the supplied ZIP archive.

title: How important are realistic building lifespan assumptions for material stock and demolition waste accounts?
study_area: Nagoya; Wakayama; Salford; national Japan and United States stock models
uncertainty_method: Lifetime-distribution alternatives; Monte Carlo input uncertainty
verified_interface: Lifetime/input uncertainty propagated to stock and demolition outputs
evidence_note: Alternative lifetime distributions are propagated into stock and demolition-waste accounts; 10,000 Monte Carlo simulations propagate input uncertainty into stock accumulation.

title: A Probabilistic Dynamic Material Flow Analysis Model for Chinese Urban Housing Stock
uncertainty_method: Bootstrap; Monte Carlo; confidence intervals; Spearman uncertainty importance
evidence_note: Population, urbanization, floor area, building lifetime and material intensity are probabilistically represented; bootstrap and Monte Carlo propagate them to stocks, construction, demolition, material inflows and outflows.

title: Tracking Construction Material over Space and Time: Prospective and Geo-referenced Modeling of Building Stocks and Construction Material Flows
uncertainty_method: Probabilistic parameter sampling using normal/lognormal/uniform/Weibull functions
verified_interface: Building-level uncertain parameters propagated to future material flows
evidence_note: Uncertain or missing building parameters are assigned probability functions and sampled; probabilistic modelling is used to calculate building-level future material flows.

title: Dynamic life cycle assessment of buildings and building stocks – A review
uncertainty_method: Review-level discussion of uncertainty and dynamic parameters
verified_interface: No empirical propagation in the review itself
evidence_note: The review identifies uncertainty and inconsistent treatment of dynamic parameters but is not itself an application-level propagation study.

title: Greenhouse Gas Emissions and Decarbonization Potential of Global Fired Clay Brick Production
verified_interface: Sensitivity only; not formal uncertainty propagation
evidence_note: Parameter uncertainty is examined through sensitivity analysis and input variance is discussed, but uncertainty distributions are not jointly propagated through the decision pathway.

title: Material intensity and embodied carbon of Korea's residential buildings over four decades
uncertainty_method: Joint bootstrap of EPD emission-factor distributions
evidence_note: Carbon-emission-factor distributions are jointly bootstrapped 1,000 times and propagated to embodied-carbon estimates with standard errors and 95% confidence intervals.

title: Pathways to a net zero building sector in Colombia: Insights from a circular economy perspective
verified_interface: Sensitivity analysis; no uncertainty distribution propagated
evidence_note: Population, lifetime, housing size and CE deployment speed are tested in sensitivity analysis, but this is not a probabilistic uncertainty-propagation framework.

title: A layered dynamic material flow framework for modeling building renovations
uncertainty_method: Parametric stock-flow model; lifetime sensitivity; model-form comparison
verified_interface: Selected uncertainty/model-form changes reach renovation-flow outputs
evidence_note: The framework explicitly estimates uncertainty associated with dimensions/material intensities and tests lifetime parameters; selected uncertainty and model-form changes alter renovation floor area and material-flow outputs, but no full joint probabilistic propagation is performed.
